item.title: Asking Eric: I have morphed into a de facto sugar daddy
item.description: Dear Deal: Sugar is in the eye of the beholder. Which is to say, every relationship works differently, has different expectations, and asks different things of its participants. You have the power to define the relationship for yourself. This isn’t an episode of “The Maury Povich Show”; no one is going to unilaterally declare you the father.
